title: Combining Textual Features for the Detection of Hateful and Offensive Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (Macro F1-score, accuracy, weighted F1-score) on classifying social media posts as Hate and Offensive (HOF) versus Not Hate or Offensive (NOT) using the HASOC challenge datasets. The evaluation relies on a combined neural network architecture leveraging BERT embeddings, character embeddings, and a multi-hot encoder of a curated hate words dictionary that captures slurs targeting various demographics.
